import os
import lightgbm as lgb
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

df = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
y = df.pop('income').astype(int)
categorical = df.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'string']).columns.tolist()
for column in categorical:
    df[column] = df[column].astype('category')

params = {
    'objective': 'binary',
    'metric': 'binary_error',
    'learning_rate': 0.1,
    'num_leaves': 10,
    'min_data_in_leaf': 20,
    'feature_fraction': 0.9,
    'bagging_fraction': 0.9,
    'bagging_freq': 1,
    'lambda_l2': 1.0,
    'verbose': -1,
    'num_threads': 4,
    'seed': 42,
}
folds = StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=1)
accuracies = []
iterations = []
for train_index, valid_index in folds.split(df, y):
    train_x, valid_x = df.iloc[train_index], df.iloc[valid_index]
    train_y, valid_y = y.iloc[train_index], y.iloc[valid_index]
    train_set = lgb.Dataset(train_x, train_y, categorical_feature=categorical)
    valid_set = lgb.Dataset(valid_x, valid_y, categorical_feature=categorical, reference=train_set)
    probe = lgb.train(params, train_set, num_boost_round=800, valid_sets=[valid_set], callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(80, verbose=False)])
    iterations.append(probe.best_iteration)
    accuracies.append(accuracy_score(valid_y, (probe.predict(valid_x, num_iteration=probe.best_iteration) > 0.5).astype(int)))
iteration = round(sum(iterations) / len(iterations))
assert sum(accuracies) / len(accuracies) >= 0.872, (accuracies, iterations)
model = lgb.train(params, lgb.Dataset(df, y, categorical_feature=categorical), num_boost_round=iteration)
model.save_model('/app/model.txt')
assert os.path.getsize('/app/model.txt') < 500 * 1024
reloaded = lgb.Booster(model_file='/app/model.txt')
assert reloaded.num_trees() == iteration
print({'cv_accuracy': sum(accuracies) / len(accuracies), 'iterations': iteration, 'bytes': os.path.getsize('/app/model.txt')})
